newsitem.title: NORWAY: Drilling programme kicks in on Aasgard oilfield.
newsitem.headline: Drilling programme kicks in on Aasgard oilfield.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Thursday extensive drilling and well completion work will swing into full gear on the Aasgard field off mid-Norway in the Norwegian Sea in April using three rigs.
Drill ship West Odin, under construction at Samsung in South Korea, will be used to complete production wells from spring 1998, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Transocean Searcher, on the field since last February, has so far drilled three wells in the Smoerbukk sub-field and has spudded its first production well on Smoerbukk South.
The rig will be joined in two months by the Transocean Arctic and Transocean Winner. A total of 58 production wells are due to be drilled on Aasgard.
